hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In a directed rooted tree, the unique root node has an in-degree of exactly zero.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate the in-degree of every node from the given directed edge list.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Identify and return the single node whose in-degree equals zero.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulates node in-degrees and locates the unique root.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching ancestral paths from every node takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-degree array requires O(n) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the root of a directed tree is the unique node with in-degree zero.
